mission: Genentech pioneers biotechnology medicines for people with serious and life-threatening diseases.

featured.responsibilities: Contribute to GenAI application projects with a Genentech team; analyze data/prototypes, collaborate with scientists and engineers, and present progress in a structured internship setting.
featured.qualifications: Currently enrolled student (or recent graduate, per posting) with interest in GenAI/ML applications in biotech; strong analytical and communication skills. Confirm degree level, work authorization, and location on the posting.

mission: NYGC advances genomic research to improve human health through technology, collaboration, and discovery.

featured.responsibilities: Analyze NGS and multi-omics datasets, build or maintain analysis pipelines, collaborate with wet-lab and clinical genomics teams, and document methods/results for internal and external partners.
featured.qualifications: MS/PhD (or equivalent experience) in computational biology, genomics, bioinformatics, or a related field; proficiency in Python or R; experience with large-scale sequencing data preferred.

mission: MSK is dedicated to ending cancer for life through patient care, research, and education.

featured.qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in a biological science (or equivalent); prior wet-lab experience; familiarity with molecular biology techniques preferred. Confirm the live MSK requisition for level and lab assignment.

featured.qualifications: BS+ in biology or a related field; attention to detail; comfort with SOPs and databases; molecular biology or scientist-support experience preferred.

mission: Janelia brings scientists and tool-builders together to solve fundamental problems in biology.

featured.responsibilities: Carry out independent or collaborative research, develop methods or tools, and share results with Janelia lab groups in a highly interdisciplinary environment.
featured.qualifications: PhD or advanced research experience in neuroscience, imaging, computational biology, or a related area, matched to the lab posting.

mission: HHMI supports discovery science for the benefit of humanity.

featured.responsibilities: Contribute to research programs or scientific infrastructure supporting HHMI investigators and institute initiatives, including experimental work, analysis, or research operations as defined by the role.
featured.qualifications: Advanced training in a relevant scientific discipline and evidence of research productivity or technical specialization for the open requisition.

mission: The Simons Foundation advances the frontiers of research in mathematics and the basic sciences.

featured.responsibilities: Support scientific programs and research initiatives that fund and enable basic science — coordinating reviews, tracking awards, and working with investigators and foundation teams.
featured.qualifications: Scientific training plus project, data, or program experience; strong writing and organizational skills. Confirm requirements on the live Simons posting.

mission: Genentech discovers and develops medicines by pushing the boundaries of science for patients with serious disease.
